name: de-social-contributions
description: German social insurance contributions for 2026, written for the self-employed and voluntary members. Covers voluntary statutory health insurance (minimum base EUR 1,318.33, ceiling EUR 5,812.50 a month, 14.0% or 14.6% plus the fund's additional rate, average 2.9%), long-term care at 3.6% with the childless surcharge and child reductions, compulsory pension insurance for the self-employed groups in § 2 SGB VI (teachers, carers, midwives, craftspeople, one-client workers) with the 18.6% rate, standard, start-phase and income-based bases, exemptions, voluntary pension contributions, the Künstlersozialkasse and the 4.9% artists' levy, accident and unemployment insurance on application, the status procedure, due dates, late surcharges and the income tax deduction, plus a short employee summary. Trigger on: Krankenkasse freiwillig, Mindestbeitrag, KSK, Künstlersozialabgabe, Rentenversicherungspflicht Selbständige, Pflegeversicherung Kinderlosenzuschlag, Statusfeststellung. Out of scope: the
